text:
```yaml
name: Bump Personal Server After Release

on:
  release:
    types: [published]

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  bump-personal-server:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: ${{ !github.event.release.prerelease }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout Hush Line
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Checkout Personal Server
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          repository: scidsg/hushline-personal-server
          token: ${{ secrets.PERSONAL_SERVER_VERSION_BUMP }}
          path: hushline-personal-server

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install requests

      - name: Bump version in Personal Server
        run: |
          HUSHLINE_VERSION="${{ github.event.release.tag_name }}"
          # Remove 'v' prefix if present
          CLEAN_VERSION="${HUSHLINE_VERSION#v}"
          
          # Update DEBIAN/control
          sed -i "s/^Version: .*/Version: ${CLEAN_VERSION}/" hushline-personal-server/DEBIAN/control
          
          # Update docker-compose.yaml
          sed -i "s|image: ghcr.io/scidsg/hushline:.*|image: ghcr.io/scidsg/hushline:${CLEAN_VERSION}|" hushline-personal-server/var/lib/hushline/docker-compose.yaml

      - name: Create Pull Request
        uses: peter-evans/create-pull-request@v6
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.PERSONAL_SERVER_VERSION_BUMP }}
          path: hushline-personal-server
          commit-message: "Bump version to ${{ github.event.release.tag_name }}"
          title: "Bump version to ${{ github.event.release.tag_name }}"
          body: |
            Automated version bump following Hush Line release ${{ github.event.release.tag_name }}.
            
            Changes:
            - Updated `DEBIAN/control` version
            - Updated `docker-compose.yaml` image tag
          branch: bump-version-${{ github.event.release.tag_name }}
          delete-branch: true
          labels: |
            automated
            release
```
